scope: FIELD root + shared cyclic carrier + first host semantic mapping

rubric.A: STATE — authoritative state exists independently of rendering
rubric.B: RELATION — relative transform has named host-owned semantics
rubric.C: GESTURE — one gesture has one primary interpretation
rubric.E: REVERSAL — cheap/local transform reverses or reopens from residue
rubric.G: RETURN — current state can be explained/re-entered from evidence
rubric.H: COMPRESSION — mechanism removes more exposed complexity than it adds

decision_rule: KEEP only when all applicable A-H pass. REPAIR only for bounded defects with unique useful behavior. DELETE when H fails structurally, relation is decorative/redundant, or capability already survives elsewhere.
